note: H8 (evidence/phase-8.md, 'Two rulings made during the run'): actions the mechanical gate flagged missing that the operator surface offers under another name and that the frozen judge's single judgement did not name missing (3.5, AC-17). Each is an instrument disagreement logged in evidence/instruments.md. Key: the cell (<brief>.<arm>); value: the flagged action and the buttons (event, label) that do it. --tally applies these and also reports the gate alone. The borga reading was made during the run; the other five on 2026-10-17, after the judge's singles on those cells and before the tally.

borga-bilingual-notice.claude-code.lang1: holdFi ('Suomi'): shows language 1 and holds it
borga-bilingual-notice.claude-code.lang2: holdSv ('Svenska'): shows language 2 and holds it

boxing-night-matchup.claude-code.select: winRed ('Red wins'), winBlue ('Blue wins'), group 'Decision': selects the winning corner

school-table-tennis-bracket.claude-code.advance: qf1Top to finalBot ('QF1 top' ... 'Final bottom'), groups 'Quarter-finals', 'Semi-finals', 'Final': advances that player to the next round

volleyball-set-board.claude-code.undoPoint: undoA ('Undo A'), undoB ('Undo B'), group 'Undo': takes a point back from that team
volleyball-set-board.claude-code.endSet: setA ('Set A'), setB ('Set B'), group 'End set': ends the set for the team the operator picks

womens-derby-head-to-head.claude-code.highlight: leadA ('Lead Home'), leadB ('Lead Away'), group 'Compare': highlights one side and dims the other

youth-game-show-podiums.claude-code.spotlight: spot1 to spot4 ('Spot P1' ... 'Spot P4'), group 'Spotlight': spotlights one podium and dims the rest
